title: Baseplate
summary: The grid that bins lock into. Plates join edge to edge into a bigger grid; glue or screw them into a drawer, onto a shelf or a wall, and bins drop in and stay put.

groups.title: Size
groups.help: Number of 42 mm grid squares. Use 'Fit to drawer' to work this out from a drawer's inside size.

groups.title: Edges & joining
groups.help: Join edges to link plates into one bigger grid: every joined edge has the same sockets, and a small bow-tie key drops into the sockets of both plates, so any joined edge fits any other. Padding adds a solid border on the edges that aren't joined, to fill leftover space in a drawer.

groups.title: Floor & mounting
groups.help: Floor thickness 0 gives an open frame. A solid floor is needed for magnets and screw holes. The light frame saves filament by lowering the middle of each grid line.

params.label: Width
params.help: Grid squares along the width (42 mm each).

params.label: Depth
params.help: Grid squares along the depth (42 mm each).

params.label: Side padding
params.help: Solid border on the left and right edges that aren't joined. 1.5 mm or more gives a strong outer rim.

params.label: Front/back padding
params.help: Solid border on the front and back edges that aren't joined.

params.label: Join left edge
params.help: Key sockets on the left edge. No padding on this edge.

params.label: Join right edge
params.help: Key sockets on the right edge. No padding on this edge.

params.label: Join front edge
params.help: Key sockets on the front edge. No padding on this edge.

params.label: Join back edge
params.help: Key sockets on the back edge. No padding on this edge.

params.label: Print keys
params.help: Prints the joint keys loose inside the front-left square: one for every two sockets, in rows of 3, so a set of plates comes with enough keys plus a few spares. Needs an open frame (floor thickness 0).

params.label: Joint clearance
params.help: Gap around each key. Raise it if keys are too tight to press in, lower it if they're loose.

params.label: Floor thickness
params.help: 0 = open frame. 3 mm or more allows magnet holes; 4 mm or more suits countersunk screws.

params.label: Light frame
params.help: Bins stand on the surface below and the frame only keeps them in place, so the middle of each grid line is cut down to a 1 mm web and only the corners keep the full profile. About 40% less filament.

params.label: Magnet holes
params.help: Four magnet pockets per square, lined up with the magnet holes in bins.

params.label: Magnet diameter
params.help: 6.5 mm fits 6 x 2 mm magnets with glue clearance.

params.label: Magnet depth
params.help: Pocket depth from the top of the floor.

params.label: Mounting screw holes
params.help: One countersunk hole in the middle of each square for screwing the plate down.

params.label: Screw clearance
params.help: Hole diameter. 4.5 mm suits #8 or M4 wood screws, 3.5 mm suits M3.

params.label: Countersink diameter
params.help: Width of the 90° countersink at the top of the floor, for flat-head screws.

checks.message: Magnet holes need a floor at least 0.6 mm thicker than the magnet depth.
The floor is too thin for the countersink: thicken the floor or reduce the countersink.
The countersink must be wider than the screw hole.
Plates over 430 mm won't fit any common printer bed.
Plates join where grid lines meet the edge: joining the left or right edge needs a depth of at least 2.
Plates join where grid lines meet the edge: joining the front or back edge needs a width of at least 2.

checks.expr: not keys or floor_t == 0 or not (join_l or join_r or join_f or join_b)
checks.message: Keys print inside the open squares, so they need floor thickness 0: print them with an open-frame plate, or turn Print keys off.

presets.name: Drawer liner
presets.help: Light open frame, glue or tape it in

presets.name: Joined plates
presets.help: Joins on every edge, with its keys; any plate fits next to any other

presets.name: Wall / shelf mount
presets.help: Screw it to a wall or shelf
